                    new_grid[r+1][c] == color and new_grid[r+1][c+1] == 0 and new_grid[r+1][c+2] == color and
                    new_grid[r+2][c] == color and new_grid[r+2][c+1] == color and new_grid[r+2][c+2] == color):
                    return (c, r)
